quiet: My brother will never share his sweets with anyone, and he hides them in his room.
We walked along the river and watched the boats come in at dusk.
The old barn is empty now since the farm sold its cows years ago.
This village is home to families who have farmed the valley for generations.
The choir sang loudly, and the audience clapped along to every song.
The old cabin belonged to my uncle, who built it with his own hands.
All the apples had fallen in the night and the grass was covered in them.
Pass the salt, said my father, without looking up from his paper.
